errors.evidence: The description incorrectly maps percentages to the outer ring categories. For the standard deviation values of 0.0, 0.47, 0.82, and 0.94, the correct percentages shown in the chart are 49.0%, 38.0%, 5.0%, and 7.0% respectively. The machine description incorrectly uses 47.7% (a value from the inner ring) and swaps the values for 0.82 and 0.94.

The description incorrectly maps percentages to the inner ring categories. For the maximum ambiguity values of 1, 2, and 3, the correct percentages shown in the chart are 47.7%, 39.0%, and 14.2% respectively. The machine description misattributes the values for the first two categories, using 39.0% and 38.0% (a value from the outer ring) instead.
